Subject: MSA: audit rights & pen test logistics

Hi Ava / Karthik,

Thanks for the quick intake on the MSA. A couple of items our procurement and security teams want to get aligned on before we move to signatures:

- SOC 2: can Redwood provide the latest SOC 2 Type II report under NDA, and confirm whether the report covers the hosted product and the dedicated/private deployments?
- Pen test language: we need to understand your standard pen-test clause and whether third-party testers are allowed to run tests against staging/test environments.
- Audit scope / evidence cadence: our security team wants a lightweight recurring evidence cadence (monthly sampling with quarterly larger bundles) and clarity on ephemeral access for evidence requests.

Could we schedule a 30-minute ops call this week to map responsibilities and confirm dates? I attached a short list of the items our auditors will check.

Attachments: Requested_Security_Topics.pdf (pdf)

Best,
Alex Rivera
Head of Security Programs
Nuvera Health
From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@nuverahealth.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 16 Jun 2025 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MSA: audit rights & pen test logistics

Alex — thanks for the clear list. Happy to map this out. High-level answers and a proposed near-term plan:

- SOC 2: we can share our most recent SOC 2 Type II report under NDA; it covers our hosted API and Redwood Dedicated (we have a separate statement for Private deployments — we can provide that appendix if needed).

- Pen tests: Redwood allows customer-run or third-party pen tests against dedicated/staging environments with a 30-day notice window. Tests against production require a formal request and a narrow blast radius; we recommend running tests in staging whenever possible.

- Evidence cadence: proposal below — monthly lightweight artifact bundles (audit tickets, config snapshots, summary logs) + quarterly deep bundles (SOC evidence mapping + sampling sets). We will provide a secure evidence portal link for uploads and temporary access.

Proposed immediate steps:
1) 30-min ops call to confirm pen-test window and evidence owners — available Tue/Wed this week (16/17) between 10–3 PT.
2) I’ll share our PenTest_Guidelines_v1 and a short evidence checklist prior to the call.
3) Karthik (Legal) will own the MSA redline path and produce an order-form amendment with the agreed audit scope.

I attached the guidelines. If that plan works, send a calendar invite and we’ll loop in Marissa on the legal redlines.

Attachments: PenTest_Guidelines_v1.docx (docx)

Thanks,
Ava Chen
Security Partnerships
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: MSA: audit rights & pen test logistics — legal redline items

Marissa — forwarding the thread to tee up redlines. Key items Legal should propose for the MSA / Order Form amendment:

- Scoped audit rights: limited to the environments explicitly listed in the Order Form (Hosted API + Dedicated staging); audit rights for Private deployments only by mutual agreement and separate appendix.
- Notice and scheduling: 30 calendar days' notice for pen tests against staging; 45 days for any requested production testing.
- Evidence access: remote, time-boxed access to artifacts via secure evidence portal; no on-prem privileged inspection unless explicitly agreed and accompanied by an inspection statement.
- Sampling & frequency: allow monthly sampling (up to 3 small-scope requests per month) and one quarterly deep-evidence bundle. Any deviation requires escalation to Legal/Security.
- Data minimization & redaction: Redwood to provide minimally needed logs; PII/PHI redaction to comply with our retention policy. Customer may request assertive redaction proofing steps.
- Confidentiality & retention: evidence retained for a maximum of 90 days in the portal unless otherwise agreed; all access logged with audit trail.

Please prepare a short redline (tracked) for the Order Form that captures these points plus an explicit fallback if timing conflicts arise (fallback: documented test run with screenshots and assisted validation).

On the call, we should confirm who the third-party testers (if any) will be, and whether Nuvera requires a pre-test questionnaire to be completed.
